record.paper_title: Open problems from the 12th International Conference on Fuzzy Set Theory and Its Applications
record.original_question: Characterize all non-additive set functions m for which, on every measurable space, strict convergence in measure with respect to m is equivalent to ordinary convergence in measure with respect to m.

evidence.quote: Problem 9.4 (O. Hutnik). Characterize all the non-additive set functions for which strict convergence in measure is equivalent to convergence in measure on any measurable space.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(X,\mathcal{A})$ be a measurable space. A non-additive (monotone) set function is a map $m:\mathcal{A}\to[0,\infty]$ with $m(\emptyset)=0$ and $m(A)\le m(B)$ whenever $A\subseteq B$. For measurable functions $f_n,f:X\to\mathbb{R}$, say that $f_n$ converges to $f$ in measure with respect to $m$ if 
$$\lim_{n\to\infty} m(\{x\in X:|f_n(x)-f(x)|\ge\varepsilon\})=0\quad\text{for every }\varepsilon>0,$$
and that $f_n$ converges strictly in measure to $f$ with respect to $m$ if additionally 
$$\lim_{n\to\infty} m(\{x\in X:|f_n(x)-f(x)|>0\})=0,$$
i.e., the measures of the supports of $f_n-f$ also tend to $0$.

Characterize all non-additive set functions $m$ with the following property: for every measurable space $(X,\mathcal{A})$ and every sequence $(f_n)$ of measurable functions and every measurable $f$, strict convergence in measure of $f_n$ to $f$ with respect to $m$ is equivalent to ordinary convergence in measure of $f_n$ to $f$ with respect to $m$.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent works (e.g., a paper on "Autocontinuity, strict convergence in measure and convergence of integral sequences" and one on strict convergence in measure theorems for seminormed/semiconormed fuzzy integrals) study related implications and provide sufficient conditions such as autocontinuity, but a complete characterization of the non-additive set functions for which strict convergence in measure coincides with convergence in measure on every measurable space does not appear to be established. Status could not be conclusively verified.

status_evidence.title: Autocontinuity, strict convergence in measure and convergence of integral sequences
status_evidence.snippet: Studies autocontinuity as a condition relating strict convergence in measure to convergence of integrals.
status_evidence.claim: Related sufficient conditions investigated, no full characterization stated.

status_evidence.title: On Strict Convergence in Measure Theorems for Seminormed and Semiconormed Fuzzy Integrals
status_evidence.snippet: Provides strict-convergence-in-measure theorems in the setting of non-additive fuzzy integrals.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work addresses strict convergence in measure for non-additive integrals without claiming the full characterization.
